en.html:
The Ootori pair and I had boarded the airship to stop the occupation forces from annihilating the shogunate with the Forged Bomb—

And failed. That was the result.
en.text:

And failed. That was the result.

ja.html:
俺と大鳥主従は、〝<ruby>鍛造雷弾<rt>フォージド・ボム</rt></ruby>〟による進駐軍の幕府
壊滅計画を阻止すべく、飛行艦に侵入し――
　そして失敗した。
ja.text:
俺と大鳥主従は、〝鍛造雷弾フォージド・ボム〟による進駐軍の幕府
壊滅計画を阻止すべく、飛行艦に侵入し――
　そして失敗した。

en.html:
All our efforts, and the Forged Bomb was dropped anyway.

But even for Lieutenant Colonel Cannon, who commanded the operation, apparently that was the last item to go according to plan.

The blast battered the airship too.
Surely the plan had allowed enough margin to keep the ship safe. Something outside the calculation must have entered. The bomb malfunctioning—or some other factor. Which, I could not say.

ja.html:
試み虚しく、鍛造雷弾は投下された。

　だが、作戦主任のキャノン中佐にとっても、目論見
通りであったのはそこまでの事に過ぎなかったらしい。

　爆風は、飛行艦をも激しく煽った。
　計画の上では船の安全を充分に確保していたに違い
ないから、何処かで計算外の要素が絡んだのだろう。
爆弾の誤作動か――はたまた別の要因か。

en.html: The airship took enormous damage and had to make an emergency landing. That opening gave us our escape. Bas, escaped, matter finished? Neither GHQ nor Lieutenant Colonel Cannon was so obliging. We had barely brought our lives out, and already we were fighting the occupation army’s pursuers. Day, night, people watching—no concern. Attack, attack, attack. As we fled, we learned that Shishiku Ootori’s forces had, for some reason—◆Kanae told me afterward that she had sent warning of the bomb through an intermediary—◆escaped its effects and were returning to Sasagawa in Aizu. We turned our course that way.
en.text:
The airship took enormous damage and had to make an emergency landing. That opening gave us our escape.
Bas, escaped, matter finished? Neither GHQ nor Lieutenant Colonel Cannon was so obliging.

We had barely brought our lives out, and already we were fighting the occupation army’s pursuers.
Day, night, people watching—no concern. Attack, attack, attack.

As we fled, we learned that Shishiku Ootori’s forces had, for some reason—◆Kanae told me afterward that she had sent warning of the bomb through an intermediary—◆escaped its effects and were returning to Sasagawa in Aizu. We turned our course that way.

ja.html: 甚大な損傷を蒙った飛行艦は不時着を余儀なくされ、 俺達はその隙に脱出を果たすことができた。 　といってそれきり放置してくれるようなＧＨＱでは なく、キャノン中佐ではない。 　命辛々からがらの脱出の後には、進駐軍から放たれた追手と の熾烈な抗争が待っていた。 　昼夜も人目も顧みぬ襲撃、襲撃、襲撃。 　逃走を重ねる中、大鳥獅子吼の軍勢が如何なる理由 によってか――◆人伝ひとづてに雷弾の事を通報しておいたのだ と香奈枝嬢から後で聞かされた――◆爆弾の被害を免れ、 会津篠川に帰還すると知り、進路をそちらへ向け。
ja.text:
甚大な損傷を蒙った飛行艦は不時着を余儀なくされ、
俺達はその隙に脱出を果たすことができた。
　といってそれきり放置してくれるようなＧＨＱでは
なく、キャノン中佐ではない。

　命辛々からがらの脱出の後には、進駐軍から放たれた追手と
の熾烈な抗争が待っていた。
　昼夜も人目も顧みぬ襲撃、襲撃、襲撃。

　逃走を重ねる中、大鳥獅子吼の軍勢が如何なる理由
によってか――◆人伝ひとづてに雷弾の事を通報しておいたのだ
と香奈枝嬢から後で聞かされた――◆爆弾の被害を免れ、
会津篠川に帰還すると知り、進路をそちらへ向け。

en.html:
Only after crossing the provincial border did we finally shake them off. The Sasagawa army gave our pursuers something to be cautious about, and their pace slackened.

So we reached here—the Nagakura house. Sayo’s family home.

ja.html:
國境を越えてようやく、篠川軍に憚って足の緩んだ
追手を振り切り。
　そうして、<ruby>此処<rt>ここ</rt></ruby>――さよ侍従の実家、永倉家に辿り
着いたのだ。
ja.text:
國境を越えてようやく、篠川軍に憚って足の緩んだ
追手を振り切り。
　そうして、此処ここ――さよ侍従の実家、永倉家に辿り
着いたのだ。

en.html:
...The result, then.
Yamato had not lost its independence. The thing I had dreaded had not happened.

The bomb had fallen.
But Shishiku Ootori, one of the Four Great Kubo, had survived. More than that, he had rescued Shirou Kuniuji, now head of the Ashikaga clan after Moriuji’s death. This was public fact already.

Rokuhara was not dead. The Sasagawa Kubo’s government and its district army remained intact, facing the occupation forces.
There were said to be other survivors of Fudaraku Castle too, many gathering in Aizu. True or not, still unconfirmed.

If true, the Forged Bomb had achieved less than Cannon and the others intended.
Its impact on the minds of Yamato’s people must have been considerable. But considerable and decisive were not the same thing. One did not become the other merely because Cannon needed it.

Many were praising the occupation forces for finally attacking Rokuhara, for dealing it such a blow. Fine. Praise did not mean the country was ready to install them as its new masters. That welcome was nowhere near prepared.

Let GHQ announce such a thing now, and protest would sweep Yamato immediately. All their work, back to square one.

Therefore—
If the occupation forces, if Lieutenant Colonel Cannon, still insisted on ruling Yamato, they would have to obtain the military result the bomb had failed to produce.

Advance as quickly as possible. Destroy Rokuhara at its new seat in Aizu.
No other way.

As long as time kept moving, that future was already fixed.
War would trample this province of Aizu.

If true, the Forged Bomb had achieved less than Cannon and the others intended.
Its impact on the minds of Yamato’s people must have been considerable. But considerable and decisive were not the same thing. One did not become the other merely because Cannon needed it.

Many were praising the occupation forces for finally attacking Rokuhara, for dealing it such a blow. Fine. Praise did not mean the country was ready to install them as its new masters. That welcome was nowhere near prepared.

ja.html:
……結果として。
　俺が忌避した、大和の自立を失わしめる事態は実現
していない。

　爆弾は落ちた。
　しかし四大公方の一角たる大鳥獅子吼が死なず……
しかも彼は護氏亡き後の足利一族総領、四郎邦氏をも
救い出している。これは既に公表された事実だ。

　六波羅は滅びていない。篠川公方府は管区軍と共に
健在であり、進駐軍に対峙する構えを見せている。
　真偽はまだ不明だが、普陀楽城の生き残りは他にも
存在し、その多くが会津へ参集しつつあるとも云う。

　それが事実なら、鍛造雷弾はキャノン中佐らが意図
した程の実効を示さなかったのだろう。
　従って、大和国民の心理へ与えた影響は相当のもの
であったには違いないが、これもまだ決定的ではない。

　六波羅に対して遂に攻撃を行い、大打撃を与えたに
ついては賞賛の声も少なくないものの、その進駐軍を
幕府に代わる支配者として受け入れる土壌までが出来
上がっているとは到底言えなかった。

　仮に今、ＧＨＱがそんな宣言を発すれば反発の声は
忽ち大和全土を渦巻くだろう。
　そうなっては何もかも元の木阿弥だ。

　だから。
　進駐軍が――キャノン中佐があくまでも大和支配に
固執するならば、鍛造雷弾投下では挙げられなかった
戦果を補うしかない。

　可及的速やかに軍を進め、会津に居を移した六波羅
を討ち滅ぼす。
　そうするしかない。

　時間が滞りなく流れてゆく限りにおいて、最早確定
しているのだ。
　この会津國が戦火に蹂躙されるという未来は。
